name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new construction condominium in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical deposit structure for a new construction condominium in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: For new construction condominiums in Florida, particularly in high-demand areas like Miami or Fort Lauderdale, the deposit structure typically involves several stages. An initial reservation deposit, usually 10-20% of the purchase price, is made upon contract signing. Subsequent deposits, often an additional 10-20% at various construction milestones, are common. It's crucial to understand the full deposit schedule, as these funds are often non-refundable after certain periods or events.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction condo deposits in Florida usually start with 10-20% at contract, followed by additional deposits at construction milestones. These funds are often non-refundable.
